descriptions.notStarted: I wonder what all the commotion is about. Rumor has it that there's a race going on. The team that collects the most Notebooks will win. The reward is also said to be very nice...
descriptions.inProgress: I'm really anxious to find out which team is winning. I gotta get more players involved to win this race!
descriptions.completed: I gave Maple Administrator the Notebook. She seemed very ecstatic, as if it was for him... seriously, what did she do with all those notebooks?
